title: No test infrastructure configured
reasoning: The project has no test script or testing framework dependencies (detected commands show test: null). For a React application with routing, charting, and file processing capabilities, the lack of any testing infrastructure is a significant quality and maintainability risk. Regressions cannot be detected automatically, and refactoring becomes hazardous.
recommendation: Add a testing framework suitable for React applications. For a Vite + React + TypeScript project, consider Vitest with React Testing Library. Install vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, and jsdom as devDependencies. Add script: '"test": "vitest"'
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature includes no tests, and this finding identifies the absence of testing infrastructure itself.
